subject: Coordinating on-prem/VPC architecture review — availability & pre-reads
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@medtrax.io>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medtrax.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: on-prem architecture next steps and availability

Hi Sam / Lena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side: MedTrax is prioritizing a private hosting option (VPC or on-prem) for PHI workloads, you expect ~120k tokens/day steady state with occasional 10-20% bursts, and your compliance team requires KMS integration + audit log retention for 2 years.

Next steps we recommended on the call:
- Technical deep-dive (90 minutes) with infra + security to review network topology, firewalling, and KMS/HSM options
- Share MedTrax network diagram and any compliance checkpoints in advance
- Confirm scope (VPC-only vs on-prem full-install) and success criteria for the pilot

Are you available for a deep-dive next week? We have the following windows (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-27 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-10-28 09:00–10:30
- Thu 2026-10-29 14:00–15:30

I’m looping in Marissa (solutions engineer) to lead the architecture walkthrough. I attached a short checklist and a suggested agenda to help prep. If those slots don’t work, tell us two alternative times and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: redwood-priv-onprem-checklist.pdf (short checklist), medtrax-network-drawings.pdf (please attach if you have them — we referenced a handful of diagrams on the call)

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick operational notes ahead of Wednesday’s deep-dive:

Agenda (90m) — Wed 2026-10-28 09:00–10:30 PT
- 00:00–10: Min product/context (Mina)
- 10–50: Network topology & firewall walk (Marissa + Javier)
- 50–75: KMS/HSM and key rotation patterns (security leads)
- 75–90: Pilot success criteria, next steps, and owners

Prep requests for your team (Lena / Javier):
